gallery.title: A Journey Through History - Museum Rooms
gallery.intro: We begin our journey inside the museum... where each room tells a chapter of the Egyptian army's history over seven thousand years.
gallery.room1_desc: Witness Narmer unifying the two lands with the first organized army using stone and leather weapons.
gallery.room2_desc: The army of the pyramid builders. Copper weapons, strict organization, and protection of routes.
gallery.room3_desc: Renewed power… developed axes, wooden shields, and fortresses extending south towards Nubia.
gallery.room4_desc: The Imperial Era. War chariots, composite bows, and bronze Khopesh. The first army to use rapid maneuvers.
gallery.room5_desc: A mixed army of Egyptians and Greek mercenaries. Hoplon shields and long Phalanx spears.
gallery.room6_desc: Scutum shields, Gladius swords, long Sarissas, and heavy iron helmets.
gallery.room7_desc: Curved swords, chainmail, Ayyubid and Mamluk knights facing Crusaders. Battles of Hittin and Ain Jalut.
gallery.room8_desc: The strongest knights of the East. Composite bows, scale armor, and Turkish swords in full simulation.
gallery.room9_desc: The age of gunpowder. Matchlock rifles, massive cannons, and Janissary uniforms.
gallery.room10_title: Room 10: Era of Muhammad Ali & Monarchy
gallery.room10_desc: The start of the modern army. The Tarbush, military schools, European rifles, and regional campaigns.
gallery.room11_desc: The July Revolution, professional national army, and the October War room: crossing maps and victory leaders.
gallery.room12_desc: Nasser's pistol, Sadat's watch, Mubarak's helmet, and history written by hand.
gallery.room13_desc: Crawl tunnels, climbing walls, and interactive maps to teach children the meaning of defending the homeland.
gallery.room14_desc: A hall dedicated to the elite units and great commanders who shaped military history.
gallery.room15_title: Room 15: Sinai Heroes and Unnamed Martyrs
gallery.room15_desc: Honoring the brave heroes of Sinai and the unknown martyrs who sacrificed for the nation.
gallery.conclusion: This is a full history... a civilization... and a heroic army that protected Egypt over seven thousand years.
